user.title: Configure CircuitSetup Energy Analyzer
user.description: Step 1: select source devices or extra source sensors. Submit saves these source settings.

data_description.source_devices: Select ESPHome meter devices to include their matching energy sensors.
data_description.extra_source_entities: Optional individual sensors for power, voltage, current, energy, frequency, reactive power, apparent power, or power factor.
data_description.enable_experimental_nilm: Turns on experimental mains disaggregation features for aggregate load analysis.
data_description.mains_source_entities: Optional aggregate mains sensors for NILM. For split-phase topology evidence, use L1/L2 or leg A/B-style power entity names.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Optional temperature sensor used to compare HVAC activity with outdoor conditions.
data_description.rain_sensor_entity: Optional binary sensor that is on when it is raining. Used to explain expected sump, well pump, or water pump activity.
data_description.rain_intensity_entity: Optional precipitation-rate sensor. If available, heavier rain can raise expected pump activity more than light rain.
data_description.water_flow_sensor_entities: Optional binary or numeric water-flow sensors. Binary sensors are active when on; numeric flow-rate sensors are active when greater than 0.
data_description.sensitivity: Controls how quickly possible issue alerts are raised. Quiet raises fewer alerts, Balanced is the default, and Sensitive is more responsive.
data_description.retention_mode: Controls retained diagnostic evidence and events. Lightweight keeps 14 days, Standard keeps 45 days, and Diagnostic keeps 180 days; longer retention uses more storage.

assign.title: Assign Circuit Appliances
assign.description: The form is prefilled from automatic classification or your saved assignment. Circuit Mode and Power Flow are selected automatically from Appliance Type. Current classification: {appliance_profile} / {circuit_mode} / {power_flow}.

data_description.include_circuit: Turn this off to leave the selected sensors out of appliance-specific analysis.
data_description.remove_from_analysis: Removes this appliance from analyzer configuration after reload. Source sensors stay in Home Assistant and can be selected again later.
data_description.included_sensors: Unchecked sensors stay available in source selection but are not used for this appliance.
data_description.circuit_name: Edit the display name used for this analyzed circuit.
data_description.appliance_profile: Choose the appliance type used for automatic analysis and alerts.
data_description.circuit_retention_mode: Overrides retained diagnostic history for this circuit. Lightweight keeps 14 days, Standard keeps 45 days, and Diagnostic keeps 180 days; longer retention uses more storage.

nilm.title: Experimental NILM Settings
nilm.description: Optional: choose configured appliance circuits whose known events should be masked from mains NILM discovery.

data_description.known_load_circuits: Select individual load circuits, not mains circuits. These known loads help separate expected events from unknown aggregate mains events.

utility.title: Utility / Opower Comparison
utility.description: Optional: compare Utility or Opower energy data with mains measurement data or a selected sum of measured kWh sensors.

data_description.enable_utility_comparison: Turn this on to create utility comparison sensors for the selected circuit.
data_description.circuit_id: Choose the circuit to compare. Mains is usually the right choice for utility bill data.
data_description.utility_energy_entity: Optional utility or Opower kWh entity to use when recorder statistics are not available.
data_description.utility_statistic_id: Optional recorder statistic ID for Utility or Opower kWh data.
data_description.utility_source_type: Choose Auto to prefer statistics when available and fall back to the selected entity.
data_description.utility_statistic_period: Choose the recorder period to compare against measured kWh data.
data_description.measured_energy_entities: Optional measured kWh entities to sum; leave blank to use the analyzer's circuit energy total.
data_description.tolerance_percent: Alert when the measured and utility totals differ by more than this percent.

error.no_source_entities: Select at least one source sensor.
error.invalid_source_devices: Source meter devices must be text values.
error.invalid_source_entities: Source sensor entity IDs must be text values.
error.invalid_circuit_assignments: Circuit assignments must use the generated line format.
error.invalid_mains_source_entities: Mains NILM source entity IDs must be text values.
error.invalid_known_load_circuits: Known load circuits must be selected from configured appliance circuits.
error.invalid_water_flow_sensor_entities: Water flow sensor entity IDs must be text values.

init.title: CircuitSetup Energy Analyzer options
init.description: Choose whether to review circuit appliance assignments, edit source sensors, mains sensors, NILM settings, utility comparison, recommended dashboard, entity detail level, or advanced circuit settings.

sources.title: Edit Source Selection
sources.description: Tune source devices, extra source sensors, diagnostics, and NILM. Submit saves these source settings.

data_description.source_devices: Select ESPHome meter devices to include their matching energy sensors.
data_description.extra_source_entities: Optional individual sensors for power, voltage, current, energy, frequency, reactive power, apparent power, or power factor.
data_description.enable_experimental_nilm: Turns on experimental mains disaggregation features for aggregate load analysis.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_entity: Optional temperature sensor used to compare HVAC activity with outdoor conditions.
data_description.rain_sensor_entity: Optional binary sensor that is on when it is raining. Used to explain expected sump, well pump, or water pump activity.

mains.title: Edit Mains Sensors
mains.description: Select optional aggregate mains sensors used for Mains NILM and whole-home comparison features.

data_description.mains_source_entities: Optional aggregate mains sensors for Mains NILM. For split-phase topology evidence, use L1/L2 or leg A/B-style power entity names.

nilm.title: Experimental NILM Settings
nilm.description: Choose configured appliance circuits whose known events should be masked from mains NILM discovery.

data_description.known_load_circuits: Select individual load circuits, not mains circuits. These known loads help separate expected events from unknown aggregate mains events.

utility.title: Utility / Opower Comparison
utility.description: Optional: compare Utility or Opower energy data with mains measurement data or a selected sum of measured kWh sensors.

data_description.enable_utility_comparison: Turn this on to create utility comparison sensors for the selected circuit.
data_description.circuit_id: Choose the circuit to compare. Mains is usually the right choice for utility bill data.
data_description.utility_energy_entity: Optional utility or Opower kWh entity to use when recorder statistics are not available.
data_description.utility_statistic_id: Optional recorder statistic ID for Utility or Opower kWh data.
data_description.utility_source_type: Choose Auto to prefer statistics when available and fall back to the selected entity.
data_description.utility_statistic_period: Choose the recorder period to compare against measured kWh data.
data_description.measured_energy_entities: Optional measured kWh entities to sum; leave blank to use the analyzer's circuit energy total.

entity_detail.title: Entity Detail Level
entity_detail.description: Choose how many analyzer entities Home Assistant should enable by default. You can still enable disabled diagnostic entities later from the entity registry.

data_description.entity_detail_level: Simple enables summary entities only. Standard also enables configured feature status entities. Expert enables detailed diagnostic entities for troubleshooting and custom dashboards.
data_description.apply_entity_detail_profile: Apply the selected profile to current analyzer entities. Entities you manually disabled remain disabled.

dashboard.title: Recommended Dashboard
dashboard.description: Create or update a CircuitSetup Energy Analyzer dashboard using the selected layout.

data_description.dashboard_layout: Simple shows core health, activity, electrical health, energy summary, daily energy, and running state. Standard adds configured feature status entities. Expert adds diagnostics and evidence links.

select_assignment.title: Select Assignment
select_assignment.description: Choose one current appliance or circuit assignment to edit.

data_description.selected_assignment: Choose the existing appliance or circuit assignment to edit.

select_advanced_circuit.title: Select Circuit
select_advanced_circuit.description: Choose the circuit whose advanced analyzer settings you want to edit.

data_description.circuit_id: Choose the existing appliance or circuit to tune.

advanced_settings.title: Advanced Circuit Settings
advanced_settings.description:
**{circuit_name}**

Appliance type: {appliance_profile}. Circuit mode: {circuit_mode}. Power flow: {power_flow}. This form shows only the sections that apply to the selected appliance or circuit, including billing, standby, power-quality, mains, and solar sections when relevant.

analysis_settings.name: Sensitivity
analysis_settings.description: Controls how quickly this appliance or circuit raises possible-issue alerts.

data_description.preset: Controls alert sensitivity for this circuit only.

energy_settings.name: Energy Usage And Goals
energy_settings.description: Daily kWh spike and goal settings for circuits with energy sensors.

data_description.window_days: Number of days used for daily kWh spike comparison.
data_description.daily_spike_ratio: Fraction over the rolling window total that counts as a usage spike.
data_description.daily_goal_kwh: Optional daily kWh goal for this circuit.
data_description.goal_alert_ratio: Alert when daily usage reaches this fraction of the goal.

activity_settings.name: Run And Activity Alerts
activity_settings.description: Optional active and idle duration limits for dedicated appliance circuits.

data_description.max_active_minutes: Optional longest expected active period before an activity alert.
data_description.max_idle_minutes: Optional longest expected idle period before an activity alert.

billing_cost_settings.name: Billing And Cost
billing_cost_settings.description: Billing-cycle budgets and time-of-use cost tracking.

data_description.cycle_start_day: Billing or cost cycle start day of the month.
data_description.budget_kwh: Optional billing-cycle kWh budget for this circuit.
data_description.budget_alert_ratio: Alert when projected cycle usage reaches this fraction of the budget.
data_description.billing_min_elapsed_days: Minimum days into the billing cycle before projected-budget alerts can be raised.
data_description.default_rate_per_kwh: Optional default utility rate for circuit cost tracking.
data_description.tou_rate_per_kwh: Optional time-of-use rate for the configured peak window.
data_description.tou_start: Optional peak-rate start time using the time picker.
data_description.tou_end: Optional peak-rate end time using the time picker.
data_description.tou_weekdays: Choose the weekdays where peak pricing applies.
data_description.tou_name: Display name for the time-of-use rate window.

demand_capacity_settings.name: Demand And Capacity
demand_capacity_settings.description: Rolling demand and breaker-capacity thresholds for high-load circuits.

data_description.demand_limit_w: Optional watt limit for demand alerts.
data_description.breaker_amps: Optional breaker size in amps for capacity alerts.
data_description.warning_ratio: Alert when estimated capacity reaches this fraction of breaker size.

standby_settings.name: Always On And Standby
standby_settings.description: Standby and always-on thresholds for appliance circuits.

data_description.window_hours: Hours used to learn the low-power standby watermark.
data_description.standby_threshold_w: Minimum watts considered standby or always-on usage.
data_description.always_on_alert_w: Optional watts limit for always-on usage alerts.
data_description.standby_min_samples: Minimum retained samples before standby and always-on estimates are considered ready.

water_context_settings.name: Water Context
water_context_settings.description: Rain, HVAC condensate, and optional flow-sensor context for pump and water-using appliances.

data_description.rain_pump_correlation_enabled: Compare pump activity with rain and HVAC compressor activity before flagging unusual pump runtime.
data_description.rain_response_window_minutes: Minutes after rain starts or continues where higher pump activity may be expected.
data_description.rain_activity_delta_threshold_pct: Percent above the weather-adjusted expected pump runtime before repeated possible-issue evidence can be raised.
data_description.water_flow_correlation_enabled: Compare binary or numeric water-flow sensors with mapped water-using appliances.
data_description.linked_flow_sensor_entities: Optional binary or numeric flow sensors to use for this appliance. Leave blank to use the global water-flow sensors.
data_description.expects_water_flow: Turn this off for appliances or pumps that should not correspond to the selected flow sensors.
data_description.flow_mismatch_threshold_minutes: Minutes of unexplained flow or appliance activity before the mismatch is considered evidence.

dual_phase_settings.name: Dual-Phase Leg Imbalance
dual_phase_settings.description: Split-phase imbalance thresholds for 240 V circuits.

data.leg_imbalance_min_total_power_w: Leg Imbalance Minimum Total Power W

data_description.leg_imbalance_warning_ratio: Split-phase imbalance ratio that can trigger repeated possible-issue alerts.
data_description.leg_imbalance_min_total_power_w: Minimum combined watts before dual-phase leg imbalance is evaluated.

power_quality_settings.name: Power Metric Consistency
power_quality_settings.description: Tolerance settings for W, VA, current, and power-factor consistency checks.

data_description.apparent_power_tolerance_percent: Allowed percent mismatch between reported VA and voltage-current VA.
data_description.power_factor_tolerance: Allowed mismatch between reported and expected power factor.
data_description.minimum_apparent_power_va: Minimum apparent power before W, VA, and power-factor consistency is evaluated.

mains_balance_settings.name: Mains Balance
mains_balance_settings.description: Mains-minus-monitored-load tolerance for aggregate mains circuits.

data_description.balance_negative_tolerance_w: Negative mains balance watts allowed before monitored loads are flagged.

solar_flow_settings.name: Solar Flow
solar_flow_settings.description: Solar export and flexible-load thresholds for mains circuits with generation sources.

data_description.solar_export_tolerance_w: Extra export watts allowed before solar flow is considered inconsistent.
data_description.solar_surplus_threshold_w: Export watts required before solar surplus is considered available.
data_description.high_solar_surplus_threshold_w: Export watts required before solar surplus is classified as high.
data_description.flexible_load_running_threshold_w: Watts required before a flexible load is treated as active.

data_description.setting_suggestion_ids: Select one or more pending setting suggestions to apply, deny, or dismiss together.
data_description.recommendation_action: Choose what to do with the checked settings suggestions.

assign.title: Assign Circuit Appliances
assign.description: The form is prefilled from automatic classification or your saved assignment. Circuit Mode and Power Flow are selected automatically from Appliance Type. Current classification: {appliance_profile} / {circuit_mode} / {power_flow}.

data_description.include_circuit: Turn this off to leave the selected sensors out of appliance-specific analysis.
data_description.remove_from_analysis: Removes this appliance from analyzer configuration after reload. Source sensors stay in Home Assistant and can be selected again later.
data_description.included_sensors: Unchecked sensors stay available in source selection but are not used for this appliance.
data_description.circuit_name: Edit the display name used for this analyzed circuit.
data_description.appliance_profile: Choose the appliance type used for automatic analysis and alerts.
data_description.circuit_retention_mode: Overrides retained diagnostic history for this circuit. Lightweight keeps 14 days, Standard keeps 45 days, and Diagnostic keeps 180 days; longer retention uses more storage.

error.recommendations_not_loaded: The analyzer is not loaded yet. Start the integration, then come back to review suggested settings.
error.invalid_recommendation: Choose one of the pending suggested settings.

missing_source_entities.title: Energy Analyzer source sensors are missing
missing_source_entities.description: The integration has no configured source sensors. Add at least one CircuitSetup energy sensor before appliance analysis can start. Suggested fix: {fix}

missing_required_sensor.title: Energy Analyzer source sensor is missing
missing_required_sensor.description: A configured circuit is missing a required source sensor. Reconfigure the circuit mapping before appliance analysis can continue. Suggested fix: {fix}

phase_mismatch.title: Energy Analyzer phase pairing looks suspicious
phase_mismatch.description: A dual-phase circuit has source data that does not look like a valid paired load. Review the selected channels and CT orientation. Suggested fix: {fix}

stale_source_sensor.title: Energy Analyzer source sensor is stale
stale_source_sensor.description: A configured source sensor has not updated recently. Appliance analysis is paused for the affected circuit. Suggested fix: {fix}

missing_energy_source.title: Energy Analyzer circuit needs cumulative energy data
missing_energy_source.description: {circuit_name} has power data but no usable cumulative kWh source. Reason: {reason}. Next step: {recommended_action}. You can add a cumulative energy sensor, or create one with Home Assistant's Integration helper. Suggested fix: {fix}

missing_mains_source.title: Energy Analyzer feature needs a mains source
missing_mains_source.description: {circuit_name} has a mains-dependent feature enabled, but no mains or whole-home source is configured. Reason: {reason}. Next step: {recommended_action}. Add a mains source before using mains balance, NILM, or solar-flow checks. Suggested fix: {fix}

missing_electrical_metrics.title: Energy Analyzer circuit needs matching electrical metrics
missing_electrical_metrics.description: {circuit_name} is missing the supporting watts, amps, voltage, apparent power, or power factor inputs needed for metric-consistency checks. Reason: {reason}. Next step: {recommended_action}. Suggested fix: {fix}

check_ct_direction.title: Energy Analyzer found a power-flow or CT direction problem
check_ct_direction.description: Analyzer evidence for {circuit_name} suggests reversed CT orientation, an unexpected export sign, or a power-flow mapping mismatch. Reason: {reason}. Next step: {recommended_action}. Suggested fix: {fix}

dual_phase_missing_leg.title: Energy Analyzer dual-phase circuit is missing one leg
dual_phase_missing_leg.description: {circuit_name} cannot compare both split-phase legs because one leg is missing or unavailable. Reason: {reason}. Next step: {recommended_action}. Suggested fix: {fix}

missing_rain_context_source.title: Energy Analyzer rain context needs a rain source
missing_rain_context_source.description: Rain-pump correlation is enabled for {circuit_name}, but no rain or rain-intensity source is configured. Reason: {reason}. Next step: {recommended_action}. Suggested fix: {fix}

missing_water_flow_source.title: Energy Analyzer water-flow context needs a flow source
missing_water_flow_source.description: Water-flow correlation is enabled for {circuit_name}, but no linked or global water-flow source is configured. Reason: {reason}. Next step: {recommended_action}. Suggested fix: {fix}

utility_comparison_source_mismatch.title: Energy Analyzer utility comparison needs source settings
utility_comparison_source_mismatch.description: Utility comparison is enabled for {circuit_name}, but the utility source, measured kWh source, or recorder period cannot be compared. Reason: {reason}. Next step: {recommended_action}. Suggested fix: {fix}

utility_comparison_missing_utility_sourc.title: Energy Analyzer utility comparison needs utility data
utility_comparison_missing_utility_sourc.description: Utility comparison is enabled for {circuit_name}, but the utility, Opower, or recorder statistics kWh source has no comparable data. Reason: {reason}. Next step: {recommended_action}. Suggested fix: {fix}

utility_comparison_missing_measured_sour.title: Energy Analyzer utility comparison needs measured data
utility_comparison_missing_measured_sour.description: Utility comparison is enabled for {circuit_name}, but the local measured cumulative kWh source has no comparable data. Reason: {reason}. Next step: {recommended_action}. Suggested fix: {fix}

unexpected_negative_real_power.title: Energy Analyzer sees negative load power
unexpected_negative_real_power.description: A load circuit is reporting negative real power. Check CT orientation, or set the circuit power flow to generation or mains net if export is expected. Suggested fix: {fix}

missing_mains_nilm_sensor.title: Energy Analyzer mains NILM sensor is missing
missing_mains_nilm_sensor.description: Experimental NILM is enabled but a configured mains source sensor is missing or unavailable. Per-circuit analysis can continue, but NILM discovery is paused. Suggested fix: {fix}

low_nilm_confidence.title: Energy Analyzer NILM confidence is low
low_nilm_confidence.description: Experimental NILM is seeing too many overlapping aggregate events for confident signature discovery. The integration will keep these as observations instead of sending appliance notifications. Suggested fix: {fix}
